recognize_zh: 紅色箭頭指的巨大血小板呈淡紫色顆粒狀、大小約與紅血球相當，黃色箭頭指的是較小但仍大於一般血小板的大血小板；不要把巨大血小板當成紅血球或淋巴球而漏算。
features: Giant platelet (red arrow) roughly the size of a red cell with pale purple granular cytoplasm, adjacent to a small dense dark body
Large platelet (yellow arrow) clearly larger than surrounding normal platelets
Many small normal platelets and loose platelet aggregates scattered among red cells
Crowded red cells with mild crenation; no schistocytes or spherocytes evident
Strand of pink-purple amorphous material at left edge (likely smear/fibrin artifact)
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells with mild crenation and numerous normal-sized platelets with small aggregates. A giant platelet approaching the diameter of a red cell (red arrow) and a large platelet (yellow arrow) are identified. No leukocytes are present in this field. The findings illustrate platelet macrocytosis; because giant platelets may fall outside the analyzer platelet size gate, an automated count may be falsely low and should be verified on the smear.

ddx.dx: Nucleated red cell or small lymphocyte
ddx.vs: Both have a discrete dense nucleus, whereas a giant platelet is anucleate with a central granular zone.
Gray platelets are large but pale gray and agranular due to absent alpha granules, unlike these platelets with visible purple granules.

ddx.dx: Immune thrombocytopenia with young large platelets
ddx.vs: ITP shows occasional large platelets but with a genuinely low platelet count on smear, whereas this smear shows abundant platelets.
